resources.string: Detects when a call connects, times it, and alerts you \u2014 it never ends the call for you.
Shows whether Call Timer is watching for calls, and the countdown once one connects

Lets Call Timer detect when a WhatsApp voice call is on screen so it can time it and alert you. It only reads what\'s on screen while WhatsApp is open — it never reads or sends chat messages, and it never taps or controls anything in WhatsApp.
